tasks.title: Document the agreed system foundation
tasks.description: Phase 1: Document the agreed system foundation.
tasks.details: README, PRD, MVP, architecture decisions, AGENTS.md, and lowercase rules.md agree on the local-first design.
tasks.testStrategy: Review relative links, phase boundaries, authority ownership, and the entire documentation diff.

tasks.title: Provide package and development setup
tasks.description: Phase 2: Provide package and development setup.
tasks.details: Install the Python package with a lockfile, validate configuration without side effects, document Windows/Linux setup, and run CI.
tasks.testStrategy: 47 configuration/CLI tests, locked installation, wheel smoke test, and Windows/Ubuntu CI must pass.

tasks.title: Integrate Taskmaster MCP and reviewed backlog
tasks.description: Phase 3: Integrate Taskmaster MCP and reviewed backlog.
tasks.details: Pin Taskmaster and MCP dependencies; expose bounded task operations; review a dependency-linked backlog and reusable task briefs/results. Block planning/telemetry/network in the initial profile and require completion evidence.
tasks.testStrategy: Live MCP tests on a disposable copy must cover tool selection, retrieval, dependency-aware next work, status changes, evidence rejection, and no canonical backlog mutation. Run Windows/Linux CI.

tasks.title: Define runtime contracts and SQLite migrations
tasks.description: Phase 4: Define runtime contracts and SQLite migrations.
tasks.details: Define run/task/action/plan/event contracts, valid state transitions, schema migrations, transactions, IDs, and persisted budget counters. Reject cycles and stale plan revisions.
tasks.testStrategy: Use temporary databases; test duplicate IDs, invalid transitions, interrupted writes, migration rollback/reopen, and recovery without lost budgets.

tasks.title: Record events and action intent durably
tasks.description: Phase 4: Record events and action intent durably.
tasks.details: Persist correlated intent before side effects, results, decision summaries, evidence references, and usage provenance. Redact secrets and bound payload/disk retention; stop side effects when persistence fails.
tasks.testStrategy: Inject full disk/database failures and secret canaries; show no new action after failed intent persistence and useful correlated diagnostics.

tasks.title: Register bounded file tools and policy checks
tasks.description: Phase 4: Register bounded file tools and policy checks.
tasks.details: Implement listing, bounded reads, copy-without-overwrite, hashing, and new reports inside an assigned synthetic workspace. Validate typed inputs and native path containment at execution time.
tasks.testStrategy: Reject unknown tools, traversal, symlink/junction escape, oversized reads, and overwrite attempts before effects on Windows and Linux.

tasks.title: Verify file outputs independently
tasks.description: Phase 4: Verify file outputs independently.
tasks.details: Compare bytes/hashes and report contents to trusted fixture expectations. Record verification evidence separately from worker claims.
tasks.testStrategy: Corrupt an output and fabricate a worker success response; neither may yield a succeeded action or run.

tasks.title: Expose deterministic run lifecycle commands
tasks.description: Phase 4: Expose deterministic run lifecycle commands.
tasks.details: Add submit/status/cancel/resume commands backed by canonical persisted state; dispatch only ready tasks and reconcile in-flight effects on cancellation.
tasks.testStrategy: Complete the synthetic file workflow, inspect status, and cancel before dispatch and during an action. Do not claim effects were undone.

tasks.title: Reconcile crashes and bound recovery
tasks.description: Phase 4: Reconcile crashes and bound recovery.
tasks.details: Track stable action identity, total attempts, time/action limits, and uncertain effects. Reconcile actual artifacts before repeating work; preserve counters through process and plan changes.
tasks.testStrategy: Terminate before execution, after effect/before result, and after verification. Show no blind duplicate/overwrite and honest failure on exhausted or uncertain outcomes.

tasks.title: Export redacted diagnostic bundles
tasks.description: Phase 4: Export redacted diagnostic bundles.
tasks.details: Produce summary, events, permitted artifacts, checksums, and omitted-content manifest. Define retention/size policies and a consistent state backup/restore procedure.
tasks.testStrategy: Inspect exports for synthetic secrets, broken references, oversized payloads, and useful failure evidence; test database restoration.

tasks.title: Accept the execution foundation
tasks.description: Phase 4: Accept the execution foundation.
tasks.details: Run every Phase 4 acceptance scenario with a deterministic plan and synthetic inputs. Record actual environment and code revision.
tasks.testStrategy: All A01-A08 pass with evidence. This accepts only the execution foundation, not local intelligence or the full MVP.

tasks.title: Benchmark and select the local model
tasks.description: Phase 5: Benchmark and select the local model.
tasks.details: Confirm desktop/VPS resources, benchmark one shared text model, and choose placement/limits. Test Taskmaster local planning separately in a disposable backlog only after explicit enablement.
tasks.testStrategy: Record measured latency, memory, output validity, and task completion. A mock provider is not a hardware benchmark; cloud fallback stays disabled.

tasks.title: Connect the local model provider
tasks.description: Phase 5: Connect the local model provider.
tasks.details: Implement a local provider adapter with structured responses, timeouts, cancellation, usage provenance, and one active inference. No automatic paid fallback.
tasks.testStrategy: Test malformed responses/timeouts with fixtures and complete a real local-model call on the target Windows environment.

tasks.title: Implement isolated orchestrator and worker assignments
tasks.description: Phase 5: Implement isolated orchestrator and worker assignments.
tasks.details: Give workers objective, relevant evidence, allowed tools, success criteria, skill/rule references, and remaining limits. Return compact evidence-linked results and bounded local recovery.
tasks.testStrategy: Confirm children do not inherit unrelated chat context; valid local plans complete the reference workflow; invalid plans never execute.

tasks.title: Load reviewed rules and skills explicitly
tasks.description: Phase 5: Load reviewed rules and skills explicitly.
tasks.details: Add skill catalogue/loading, metadata validation, revision hashes, mandatory rules core, and initial development/diagnosis/export/handoff/memory-proposal procedures.
tasks.testStrategy: Test missing/unreviewed skills, selective supporting-file loading, revision logs, and attempts to grant permissions through text.

tasks.title: Enforce context budgets and durable handoffs
tasks.description: Phase 5: Enforce context budgets and durable handoffs.
tasks.details: Bound prompt/tool output, reserve response space, distinguish measured/estimated usage, and rehydrate a handoff from canonical state with exact evidence references.
tasks.testStrategy: Force rollover with exhausted retries and uncertain effects. Scope, progress, failures, budgets, and recoverable original evidence must survive.

tasks.title: Verify local intelligence on the desktop
tasks.description: Phase 5: Verify local intelligence on the desktop.
tasks.details: Run the actual local-model workflow and all Phase 5 gates with consultants disabled. Preserve the earlier deterministic regression checks.
tasks.testStrategy: All A09-A13 pass, with real target-machine results separated from mocks; do not claim the memory-enabled MVP yet.

tasks.title: Define vault templates and memory schemas
tasks.description: Phase 6: Define vault templates and memory schemas.
tasks.details: Create the agreed numbered Obsidian template structure, stable IDs, scope/provenance/sharing metadata, and exact-byte hashing rules outside live runtime storage.
tasks.testStrategy: Validate synthetic notes including CRLF, malformed metadata, duplicate IDs, and renamed notes; no live personal vault is committed.

tasks.title: Store exact-revision approval and retirement
tasks.description: Phase 6: Store exact-revision approval and retirement.
tasks.details: Persist authorized approval records bound to note hash, scope, reviewer, and evidence. Handle revocation/retirement and restore without reactivating stale knowledge.
tasks.testStrategy: Changing note content invalidates prior approval; unavailable registry disables retrieval; frontmatter cannot self-approve.

tasks.title: Retrieve applicable approved memory
tasks.description: Phase 6: Retrieve applicable approved memory.
tasks.details: Filter eligibility before ranking, enforce destination sharing on linked notes, log selected immutable revisions, and recheck hashes just before prompt inclusion.
tasks.testStrategy: Test approved matches, no match, private/archived/draft linked notes, conflicting facts, concurrent edits, and degraded indexes without bypassing approvals.

tasks.title: Propose lessons with conflict-safe review
tasks.description: Phase 6: Propose lessons with conflict-safe review.
tasks.details: Write idempotent drafts to 70_Inbox_Agent, attach evidence, protect human edits with expected hashes, and separate outcomes from approval.
tasks.testStrategy: Repeated proposal creates no duplicate; user edits are preserved; only an authorized exact-revision review enables later operational retrieval.

tasks.title: Accept the complete local MVP
tasks.description: Phase 6: Accept the complete local MVP.
tasks.details: Run the full synthetic workload with approved memory, one session rollover, and a draft lesson. Record release evidence for owner acceptance.
tasks.testStrategy: All A01-A17 pass, including the real Windows/local-model demonstration; Codex and Astra are disabled.

tasks.title: Define durable remote job protocol
tasks.description: Phase 7: Define durable remote job protocol.
tasks.details: Specify job/idempotency IDs, payload digest, authentication, protocol version, states, cancellation, and result integrity without SSH-session lifetime assumptions.
tasks.testStrategy: Contract tests reject mismatched payloads for an existing key, unsupported jobs, and stale/invalid messages.

tasks.title: Implement the private VPS worker service
tasks.description: Phase 7: Implement the private VPS worker service.
tasks.details: Persist remote intent/results under a dedicated service identity; bind loopback and restrict jobs to registered types; survive process/client disconnection.
tasks.testStrategy: Terminate/restart service around effects and prove durable reconciliation, authentication checks, and bounded work.

tasks.title: Submit and reconcile jobs through the private connection
tasks.description: Phase 7: Submit and reconcile jobs through the private connection.
tasks.details: Persist job identity before sending, query after lost acknowledgements, verify result identity/hashes, and handle cancellation without blind resubmission.
tasks.testStrategy: Drop submission acknowledgement, disconnect/reconnect, and cancel in-flight work; verify same job identity and no duplicate effect.

tasks.title: Document and validate actual VPS operation
tasks.description: Phase 7: Document and validate actual VPS operation.
tasks.details: Add SSH administration/tunnel instructions, systemd units, remote-job skill, and health checks, with GitHub Actions kept separate from runtime communication.
tasks.testStrategy: Run the narrow remote test job on the actual Ubuntu VPS and record restart/disconnect/cancellation evidence; do not infer success from fixtures.

tasks.title: Add optional bounded Codex advice
tasks.description: Phase 8: Add optional bounded Codex advice.
tasks.details: Confirm supported CLI/SDK access, then accept advice only after local recovery within explicit enablement/sharing/call/token/cost/time limits.
tasks.testStrategy: Disabled adapter sends nothing; disallowed evidence never leaves; advice cannot execute tools, broaden permissions, or reset budgets.

tasks.title: Evaluate the optional final Astra fallback
tasks.description: Phase 8: Evaluate the optional final Astra fallback.
tasks.details: Confirm a supported API/model and cost before implementation. Keep disabled by default; enable only by explicit owner decision as the final bounded advisor.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify disabled state, permission/data boundaries, and budget inheritance. Unavailable access remains documented rather than fabricated.

tasks.title: Benchmark optional Graphify navigation
tasks.description: Phase 8: Benchmark optional Graphify navigation.
tasks.details: Evaluate revision-aware code relationship retrieval on a fixed baseline. Distinguish extracted from inferred relationships and review any model-backed processing.
tasks.testStrategy: Compare correctness, total tokens, latency, resource usage, stale-index behavior, and disclosure against ordinary code search before adoption.

tasks.title: Benchmark optional Headroom compression
tasks.description: Phase 8: Benchmark optional Headroom compression.
tasks.details: Evaluate content-specific compression inside context selection while retaining original permitted evidence. Protect exact constraints, paths, identifiers, and errors.
tasks.testStrategy: Compare total tokens including retrieval/retries, task accuracy, latency, and memory against uncompressed baseline; do not assume advertised savings.
